name: OpenPort v1 Core Conformance Profile
securityMinimums: agent token can access only within granted policy boundaries

optionalProfiles.description: For actions with state witnesses, execution revalidates server-observed state and fails closed on mismatch with agent.precondition_failed.
Executable security profile covering state-witness revalidation, 100x idempotency replay, endpoint 429 no-side-effect behavior, and allow/deny/fail audit completeness.

Abuse-resistance profile covering revoked-token replay, cross-tenant input misuse, high-risk action misuse, preflight payload swapping, expired auto-execute windows, retry storms, malformed input fuzzing, adapter exceptions, and untrusted instruction-like export/delete requests.
Verifiable safe-routing profile covering server-computed eligibility, ranker non-expansion, current-state revalidation, app/key/actor route isolation, and privacy-minimized route evidence.

Adaptive least-privilege profile covering capability intersection, monotone child attenuation, current-state revalidation, atomic budget consumption, principal isolation, and privacy-minimized lease evidence.

Optional single-host durable lease profile covering transactional outbox persistence, uncertain-commit replay, idempotent audit recovery, runtime reconstruction, and SQLite-backed concurrent budget conservation.
